name: Park UI
install: npx @park-ui/cli add button (requires Panda CSS project; start with npx @park-ui/cli init; supports --all)
notes: shadcn-style copy-paste registry: CLI fetches per-item JSON from https://park-ui.com/registry/{framework}/{name}.json and writes source into your project. VERIFIED example: https://park-ui.com/registry/react/button.json returns files[0].content with 2423 chars of real button.tsx source (deps @ark-ui/react + react; registryDependencies button-recipe, group, loader). Index at https://park-ui.com/registry/react/index.json = 149 items: 62 registry:ui components, 56 registry:recipe (Panda CSS style recipes auto-installed as dependencies of their component), 31 registry:color (palette tokens, free). All 62 UI components are free; the only paid product is the Figma Pro Kit (a design file, not code). License: MIT at repo root (Copyright 2025 cschroeter); repo lives in the chakra-ui org since Nov 2025; CLI npm package @park-ui/cli (v1.0.1, MIT) is also MIT. IMPORTANT gotcha: the npm package named "park-ui" (v2.3.2) is an UNRELATED Vue 3 library from 2023 - "npx park-ui@latest add ..." does NOT work; use npx @park-ui/cli. Frameworks: React and Solid registries are live (62 and 63 UI items); Vue/Svelte components exist in the repo but their registry endpoints 404. Docs sidebar groups components into 9 categories used here verbatim: buttons(3), data-display(6+image), disclosure(3), feedback(5+loader), forms(23), layout(4), navigation(4), overlays(6), typography(5+span). Three items (image, loader, span) are registry-only internal helpers with no docs page - their url points at the registry JSON. Docs URLs are framework-agnostic (https://park-ui.com/docs/components/<slug>) with a client-side React/Solid code toggle.
